# Source locus

The AGENTS.md section of the official Claude Code memory documentation
describes native support beginning at version 2.1.277. The default selection
mode is claude-md-or-agents-md: project or ancestor CLAUDE instructions take
precedence over AGENTS.md. Global and managed instructions do not suppress
project AGENTS.md.

Other selection modes and builtin plugin state can change loading behavior.
The first session after an upgrade may differ. The builtin plugin identifier
changes at 2.1.285, with the older alias retained. The /memory view can show
loaded instruction files.

This locus-only capture summarizes the supplied partial section summary.
It contains no verbatim quotation and does not establish active-session loading.

# Documentation coverage protocol

## Question and source scope

Examine native Claude Code instruction-file selection under documented version,
scope and mode conditions. The source is the AGENTS.md section of the official
Claude Code memory documentation at memory#agentsmd.

## Capture method

Use a locus-only capture of the supplied partial section summary.
Distinguish documented product behavior from observed session behavior.
Do not treat a summary as a verbatim quotation or as full-page reading.

## Selection conditions covered

Record the native support floor, the default claude-md-or-agents-md mode,
project and ancestor CLAUDE precedence, and global/managed nonsuppression.
Preserve mode, builtin plugin and first-session-after-upgrade exceptions.

## Coverage limits

Coverage is one vendor and one partial documentation section.
No cross-vendor comparison, complete literature review, conceptual novelty
assessment or runtime replication is established. Active-session loading
requires evidence of the files actually loaded in that session.

documents.body:
# Native instruction-file selection

Under what documented version, scope and selection conditions does Claude Code
load AGENTS.md?

Native support begins at 2.1.277. In the default claude-md-or-agents-md mode,
project or ancestor CLAUDE instructions take precedence over AGENTS.md.
Global and managed instructions do not suppress project AGENTS.md.
The distinction between project selection and global instruction scope is
therefore necessary when interpreting the documented defaults.

Version eligibility alone does not establish which files an active session
loaded. Selection mode, builtin plugin state and upgrade-session behavior can
affect the result.

## Coverage boundary

The evidence covers one vendor's official memory documentation, limited to
the supplied partial AGENTS.md section summary. It is not a complete literature
review or a runtime replication. Related conceptual coverage and novelty are
not established.
